name: vpndetection-cloudflare
description: Block VPNs, proxies and Tor at Cloudflare's edge, on any plan, with a Worker that checks each visitor against the VPNDetection API.

VPNDETECTION_API_KEY.description: Your VPNDetection API key. Create one for free in the [console](https://app.vpndetection.io).

ACTION.description: What happens to a visitor who matches: `block`, `challenge` (a Turnstile check, which needs `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` and the `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` secret) or `log`.

PROXY_MIN_HITS.description: How many times an address must have been seen in a residential, mobile or datacenter proxy pool before those signals count.

ALLOW_IPS.description: Addresses and ranges that are never checked, comma-separated, such as `203.0.113.7, 2001:db8::/32`.

ALLOW_PATHS.description: Path prefixes that are never checked, comma-separated, such as `/webhooks/, /robots.txt`.

BLOCK_MESSAGE.description: The sentence a blocked visitor reads. Leave it empty for the default.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Your Turnstile widget's site key, for `ACTION` `challenge`. Leave it empty otherwise.

FAIL_CLOSED.description: `true` refuses visitors while the API can't be reached. The default, `false`, lets them through.

FORWARD.description: `true` passes each answer to your site in the `X-VPNDetection` request header.
